pm_kisan.summary: Income support of Rs 6,000 per year to eligible farmer families, paid in three equal instalments of Rs 2,000. Needs Aadhaar-linked bank account and e-KYC.

pmfby.summary: Crop insurance. Farmer premium is at most 2% (kharif food/oilseed crops), 1.5% (rabi food/oilseed crops) and 5% (commercial/horticultural crops); the rest is paid by the government. Report crop loss within 72 hours to the insurer, the bank or the Crop Insurance app.

kcc_loan.summary: Kisan Credit Card gives short-term farm credit from banks at subsidised interest: 2% interest subvention plus 3% prompt-repayment incentive brings the effective rate to about 4% a year on eligible loans. Apply at your bank branch or cooperative society with land papers.
kcc_loan.helpline: ask the bank branch, or Kisan Call Centre 1800-180-1551

soil_health_card.summary: Soil test card with nutrient status of your field and fertilizer advice, issued to farmers every 2-3 years; the government pays the testing cost. Ask the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture office.

kisan_call_centre.summary: Free helpline where agriculture experts answer farmers' questions in local languages, 6 am to 10 pm, all seven days.
